Embark on a short and charming puzzle-platformer adventure as Kimchi, the kitten on his journey through the history museum. Travel through stylized dioramas representing ancient Egypt and feudal Japan, all from a feline point of view. Discover fun facts and light challenges designed for a relaxed and family-friendly experience.

FEATURES

  • Explore beautiful dioramas painted with watercolors.

  • Feel the magic of the animated movie classics.

  • A heartwarming perspective on cats through the ages.

  • Light platforming and puzzle-solving with intuitive controls

  • Be a cat..
